text_block_list.text:
On this day, Biwa Hayahide was working 
hard on training alongside Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Alright, could you join me for one more 
lap?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Really? It should be just like 
usual, though...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
? Last time I joined your voluntary 
training it was 3 laps. Now it's 4 laps... 
You definitely added a lap.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. It seems there is a discrepancy 
in our understanding of what "as usual" 
means.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Lately, rather than counting reps, I 
consider my physical condition and the 
track conditions at the time, and consult 
with Trainer-kun to decide how much load 
to apply.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Clear skies today, and physical condition 
is good. I determined that increasing the 
reps by 1.3x would result in a more 
uniform distribution of workload for this 
week, so...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm good now. Let's stop talking 
about this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So Hayahide's Trainer has to put up with 
this kind of talk every single time, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, quite right. And Trainer-kun doesn't 
merely listen to my stories, either."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
After fully understanding my thoughts, 
they tell me straight whether it's good or 
bad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Save the lovey-dovey talk for 
later. Let's get this final lap started 
already.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I-I am not bragging about my love life! I 
am having a very serious discussion 
here...!

Biwa Hayahide's growth seems to have 
reached a point where even her friends can 
clearly feel it...!
